dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS (DLBCL, NOS), germinal-center B-cell-like (GCB) subtype by the Hans algorithm, primary/de novo presentation, previously untreated.

stage_iv.quote: Ann Arbor stage IV, B-symptomatic, with three extranodal organs involved.

stage_extranodal_sites.quote: Sites: right renal cortex, left adrenal gland, and liver segment VI (3 extranodal sites).

stage_b_symptoms.quote: drenching night sweats most nights, unintentional weight loss from 79 kg to 70.2 kg (11%, 8.8 kg over about 2 months), low-grade fever to 37.9 C

mn_stage_below_iv.quote: Ann Arbor stage IV, B-symptomatic, with three extranodal organs involved.

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: this is NOT high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and/or BCL2 rearrangements, and it does NOT meet the immunohistochemical double-expressor definition (MYC 20% is below the 30-40% threshold; BCL2 30% is below the >=50% threshold

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: this is NOT high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and/or BCL2 rearrangements

mn_calls_double_expressor.quote: Double-expressor status: NEGATIVE. MYC IHC 20% (<30-40%) and BCL2 IHC 30% (<50%)

prog_ipi_high.quote: IPI = 5 of 5: age >60 (67), LDH elevated (~5x ULN), ECOG PS 2, stage III/IV, more than one extranodal site.

prog_cns_ipi_high.quote: CNS-IPI = 6: age >60, elevated LDH, stage III/IV, more than one extranodal site, and kidney/adrenal involvement (weighted as 2 points).

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: R-CHOP-21 for 6 cycles (21-day cycles) with primary G-CSF support, CNS prophylaxis and tumor-lysis prophylaxis.

tx_pola_preferred.quote: R-CHOP-21 for 6 cycles (21-day cycles) with primary G-CSF support

mn_non_curative.quote: he wants treatment aimed at cure, not palliation.

mn_da_epoch.quote: Therefore R-CHOP-based standard-dose curative therapy is appropriate, intensified high-grade B-cell-lymphoma regimens are not

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: I am giving full CHOP doses despite his age, ECOG 2 and low albumin.

cns_risk_addressed.quote: CNS-IPI = 6 (highest band): age >60, LDH elevated, stage III/IV, more than one extranodal site, plus kidney and adrenal involvement (weighted 2 points). Supporting features: IPI 5/5

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: I will obtain a baseline brain MRI with contrast before treatment to document the absence of occult CNS disease

cns_prophylaxis_renal.quote: His eGFR of 50 permits 3 g/m2 provided I use nephrology-supported hydration; I will stop his ibuprofen now (it is both a renal insult and a counter-indication to methotrexate)

mn_hdmtx_now_despite_aki.quote: systemic high-dose methotrexate, 3 g/m2 IV every 2 weeks for the first 3 cycles (or on day 15 of cycles 1-3)

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT 8-12 weeks after the last cycle (timing chosen so that treatment-related inflammation has resolved, to reduce false positives): a complete metabolic response requires Deauville 1-3 with no new lesion

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: A residual avid mass at the primary site will be biopsied before I escalate therapy or add radiotherapy, since fibrosis, inflammation and post-treatment change can remain FDG-avid.

sup_tls_prophylaxis.quote: rasburicase 3.6 mg IV fixed dose on day 0 or day 1 (after checking G6PD, and repeat dosing only for rising uric acid); IV hydration 2.5-3 L/m2/day

sup_rasburicase_g6pd.quote: rasburicase 3.6 mg IV fixed dose on day 0 or day 1 (after checking G6PD, and repeat dosing only for rising uric acid)

sup_gcsf.quote: Pegfilgrastim 6 mg SC on day 2 of each cycle

sup_stop_nsaid.quote: stop ibuprofen 400 mg three to four times daily (nephrotoxicity with rising creatinine, bleeding risk with prednisone and anticipated thrombocytopenia, and it is a contraindication to methotrexate

sup_steroid_glucose.quote: prednisone will drive hyperglycemia - home glucose monitoring, proactive insulin (or metformin adjustment) rather than waiting for symptomatic hyperglycemia

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: hepatitis B surface antigen negative, total core antibody negative, surface antibody reactive (immune from vaccination - no antiviral prophylaxis and no HBV DNA monitoring required)

work_echo_reviewed.quote: baseline echo is adequate for doxorubicin (LVEF 60%, GLS -19% at the lower limit of normal)

fit_ecog_disease_related.quote: I would rather give full-dose therapy with careful monitoring than pre-emptively reduce him to R-mini-CHOP, because under-dosing is the clearest preventable cause of failure in high-risk DLBCL.
